","identifier":["WHS","Market and Trade Economics Division/WHS"],"upcoming_releases":[],"publication_agency_export_1":["ERS"]},{"id":"1154","agency":["Economic Research Service"],"title":"USDA Agricultural Projections","contact_email":"erik.dohlman@usda.gov","keywords":["agriculture","economic situation and outlook","international economics","trade","world markets"],"frequency":"Annually","status":"Active","subscribable":"Yes","resource_type":"Dataset","subject":["Farm Input and Expenditures"],"description":"The zip files below contain both previous and the most recent USDA Agricultural Projection reports, along with accompanying tables in excel format. These files contain the full report—with 10-year projections for long-term supply, use, and prices for major U.S. crops and livestock products—as well as trade tables for the major commodity exporters and importers. The reports also include supporting U.S. and international macroeconomic assumptions and other farm sector indicators, such as farm income projections. The full report and tables are released each year in mid-February, based on data available as of the prior year’s October World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates (WASDE) report. After that October WASDE release, a sub-set of tables for the next year’s projections are released in early November. These “early release” tables now contain new macroeconomic assumptions, and 10-year U.S. projections for each commodity.

","identifier":["worldag-production"],"upcoming_releases":[],"publication_agency_export_1":["FAS"]},{"id":"1659","agency":["World Agricultural Outlook Board"],"title":"World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates","contact_email":"msewadeh@oce.usda.gov","keywords":["dairy","grains","soybeans","sugars","supply","Livestock"],"frequency":"Monthly","status":"Active","subscribable":"No","resource_type":"Report","subject":["Grains and Oilseeds","Animals and Animal Products","Crops and Crop Products"],"description":"The World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates (WASDE) is prepared and released by the World Agricultural Outlook Board (WAOB). The report is released monthly, and provides annual forecasts for supply and use of U.S. and world wheat, rice, coarse grains, oilseeds, and cotton. The report also covers U.S. supply and use of sugar, meat, poultry eggs and milk, as well as Mexico’s supply and use of sugar. The WAOB chairs the Interagency Commodity Estimates Committees (ICECs), which include analysts from key USDA agencies who compile and interpret information from USDA and other domestic and foreign sources to produce the report. For more information about the WASDE process and data, visit the WASDE Report page.
